{
  "dataset_name": "advanced_iot_dataset",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "claude-opus-4.7",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "chlorophyll_zscore",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Standardized chlorophyll content using training mean and std for linear margin scaling.",
      "value_range": [-3.0, 3.0],
      "feature_family": "normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth normalized score improves linear separation along chlorophyll axis.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "clip((`Average  of chlorophyll in the plant (ACHP)` - 38.069) / 4.4442, -3.0, 3.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "plant_height_norm",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Min-max normalized plant height rate.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Bounded continuous projection useful for linear SVM weighting.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "clip((`Plant height rate (PHR)` - 37.029) / (77.037 - 37.029), 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "root_to_shoot_dry_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of dry root weight to dry vegetative weight, capturing allocation balance.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 20.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures structural allocation differences as a continuous ratio for linear margins.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "clip(`Average dry weight of the root (ADWR)` / (`Average dry weight of vegetative plants (ADWV)` + 0.01), 0.0, 20.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "root_wet_to_dry_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Water content proxy for roots via wet-to-dry weight ratio.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 30.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Continuous moisture proxy useful for linear class boundaries.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "clip(`Average wet weight of the root (AWWR)` / (`Average dry weight of the root (ADWR)` + 0.01), 0.0, 30.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "leaf_area_per_leaf",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Average area per leaf computed from total leaf area divided by number of leaves.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1000.0],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Per-unit metric reduces correlated features into a single linear signal.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "clip(`Average leaf area of the plant (ALAP)` / (`Average number of plant leaves (ANPL)` + 0.01), 0.0, 1000.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "dry_matter_balance",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Signed difference between root and vegetative dry matter percentages.",
      "value_range": [-50.0, 50.0],
      "feature_family": "contrast",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Linear contrast between two dry-matter percentages aids margin separation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "`Percentage of dry matter for root growth (PDMRG)` - `Percentage of dry matter for vegetative growth (PDMVG)`"
    },
    {
      "name": "root_size_composite",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Weighted composite of root diameter and root length capturing overall root size.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Combines correlated root size signals into a smooth normalized composite.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "clip(0.5 * (`Average root diameter (ARD)` / 16.294) + 0.5 * (`Average root length (ARL)` / 18.065), 0.0, 5.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "vegetative_vigor_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Weighted normalized composite of height, chlorophyll, and wet weight indicating shoot vigor.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 3.0],
      "feature_family": "composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Approximate linear projection along plant vigor direction.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "clip((`Plant height rate (PHR)` / 59.0) * 0.34 + (`Average  of chlorophyll in the plant (ACHP)` / 38.07) * 0.33 + (`Average wet weight of the growth vegetative (AWWGV)` / 1.248) * 0.33, 0.0, 3.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "log_leaf_area",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed leaf area to reduce skew and provide smoother linear feature.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "transform",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Log transform smooths the magnitude and stabilizes linear coefficients.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "log1p(`Average leaf area of the plant (ALAP)`)"
    },
    {
      "name": "vegetative_wet_to_dry_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Vegetative tissue moisture proxy via wet-to-dry weight ratio.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 50.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Continuous moisture proxy complementing root moisture for linear discrimination.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "clip(`Average wet weight of the growth vegetative (AWWGV)` / (`Average dry weight of vegetative plants (ADWV)` + 0.01), 0.0, 50.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "overall_growth_health",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Holistic semantic assessment of plant health combining chlorophyll level, leaf area, height, and dry matter. Scored as a normalized severity score where higher means more vigorous and healthier growth based on row-level magnitudes relative to typical ranges.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_judgment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides smooth holistic severity score that linear SVM can weight directly.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "root_shoot_imbalance_severity",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic severity score indicating how imbalanced the root system is relative to shoot system, considering diameter, length, dry/wet root weights versus vegetative dry/wet weights. Higher values denote stronger root dominance imbalance.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_judgment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures non-formulaic gestalt of allocation imbalance useful for margin-based separation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
